verdict.rationale: Kit offers per-broadcast delivery and engagement stats: recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, rates, and send status. It also reports DMARC and verification status for sending addresses, which touches the deliverability theme. However, none of the evidence shows bounce, complaint, or blocklist signals, or any guidance when deliverability degrades. Missing for 10: per-send bounce metrics, spam complaint metrics, blocklist monitoring, actionable deliverability guidance or alerts, independent corroboration.
